tijdlijn.title: Timeline
tijdlijn.subtitle: How Nyves came to be
tijdlijn.story_continues_text: Nyves is being further developed and helps people find their old Hyves profile again.

idea.title: It all starts with an idea
idea.description: These are the first traces of a conversation between Yme Bosma and Sebastian Hagens.

domain-registration.title: Domain registration
domain-registration.description: The nyves.nl domain has been registered.

first-pitch.title: First introductory pitch
first-pitch.description: Sebastian Hagens pitches the idea to the SIDNfonds.

sidnfonds-application.title: SIDNfonds pioneer project application submitted for Nyves
sidnfonds-application.description: The application has been sent to the SIDNfonds for Nyves as a pioneer project.

sidnfonds-pioneer-project.title: SIDNfonds pioneer project
sidnfonds-pioneer-project.description: Nyves has been selected as a pioneer project by the SIDNfonds and receives a € 10,000 grant for it.

development-start.title: Start of development
development-start.description: Start of the build of the Nyves application by Sebastian Hagens.

first-test-migrations.title: First test migrations
first-test-migrations.description: The first migrations are carried out for Nyves in combination with a relay at https://relay.nyves.nl.

first-media-attention.title: First media attention
first-media-attention.description: Nyves is mentioned in the AngryNerds podcast, episode number 302.

keypair-migration-start.title: Start of migration to create keypairs per username
keypair-migration-start.description: The first migration has started for Nyves, in which a nostr keypair is created for every username.

custom-relay-live.title: Custom relay live
custom-relay-live.description: The new custom-made relay for Nyves is live at https://rely.nyves.nl.

keypair-migration-completed.title: Migration for the 9+ million keypairs completed
keypair-migration-completed.description: The first migration has been completed for Nyves (9+ million keypairs created).

usernames-migration-start.title: Start of migration of all usernames
usernames-migration-start.description: For each keypair a set of so-called nostr events is now created, so that a profile can be built up that is searchable via Nyves.

hyves-back-online.title: Hyves back as a social platform, thousands of visitors for Nyves
hyves-back-online.description: On Tuesday 22 September, Hyves was brought back online as a social platform by Mediahuis. People are now searching for Hyves en masse, and Nyves is being found by thousands of people.

follow-the-money.title: Nyves mentioned by Follow The Money
follow-the-money.description: Follow The Money published an article titled "Hyves does run on American tech, contrary to what owner De Telegraaf claims".

proprivacy-podcast.title: Nyves mentioned in the ProPrivacy podcast
proprivacy-podcast.description: Hyves is discussed in this ProPrivacy podcast episode from minute 22. A little later, at minute 36, it is also about Nyves and how we can set up social media in an alternative way thanks to the open nostr protocol.

aos-collective-donation.title: And Other Stuff Collective donates $15,000 to Nyves
aos-collective-donation.description: Nyves has received a $15,0000 donation from the AOS Collective via OpenCollective.

angry-nerds-podcast.title: Nyves is featured again in the Angry Nerds podcast
angry-nerds-podcast.description: The AngryNerds discuss Hyves and conclude that building up profiles for their own Mediahuis advertising business is the only goal. And that you should not confuse it with Nyves! "They are currently indexing 8 million old Hyves accounts for web archive restores. And Nyves is based on nostr."
